purpose: Reusable quality memory for future Stratum Praxis vertical videos

passes.rule: Lead with a system-level contradiction, not a feature list.
Keep persistent brand/footer text away from top and bottom UI zones.
Short hook, fast problem setup, longest hold on CTA.
Use near-black background, bright silver body copy, one blue accent and one warning red.
Prefer low-amplitude drift over constant large motion for premium B2B visual tone.
Use one brief red conflict flash in the middle rather than repeated effects.
Name actual operating artifacts such as master policy, adapters, conflict checks and human gates.
End with one short promise, visible price, direct product path and no competing action.
Narration must dominate; BGM remains below speech and supports transitions only.
Prefer 'individually right / system still fails' framing and preserve a long readable final hold.

learning_policy: After each published video, compare real reach/retention/click signals before promoting a pattern from candidate to default. Do not infer wins from one post.
